parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespaces page in the SchedulerX console.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 update-namespace --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-name Test_Namespace --description Namespace_reserved_for_testing --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun schedulerx2 UpdateNamespace --region cn-hangzhou --NamespaceName Test_Namespace --Description Namespace_reserved_for_testing --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace 'adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000'
